name: moult-monorepo
description: Moult — a general plugin runtime for safe replacement. Root workspace: tooling and scripts only; published code lives in packages/.

scripts.verify: pnpm build && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm -r lint && pnpm knip:verify
scripts.test:adapters: pnpm --filter @moult/test test && pnpm --filter @moult/events test && pnpm --filter @moult/react test && pnpm --filter @moult/vite test && pnpm --filter @moult/example-command-host test && pnpm --filter @moult/example-worker-host test && pnpm --filter @moult/example-integration-demo test
scripts.check:pkg: pnpm --filter @moult/runtime --filter @moult/test --filter @moult/events --filter @moult/react --filter @moult/vite exec publint && pnpm --filter @moult/runtime --filter @moult/test --filter @moult/events --filter @moult/react --filter @moult/vite exec attw --pack .
